values: Trace R10 repairs for the 63 unsuccessful R9 confirmation cases.
R10 is development calibration, not a final experiment lock.
Complete graph paths, authoritative per-node property ownership, table attribution, controlled selectors, evidence relationships, and formula roles.
Schema-v2 contracts are checked locally for exact terms, indexing, required fields, object-path kind, path domain/range compatibility, and owner/domain compatibility.
I2-008 is a non-self-contained umbrella statement; its complete downstream formula clauses remain active.
No API calls were made while constructing or validating R10.

values: Replace the presence-only checks for bowShapeCoefficient, totalGlancingImpactForce, glancingImpactLineLoad, and glancingImpactPressure with bounded formula-derived constraints that explicitly bind each required area case to the ship's actual bowShape, recompute the expected results from the verified formula operands, and compare reported derived decimals using tolerances scaled from the expected values. Do not invent equations or use exact equality; if the verified equations are unavailable, keep this requirement at the calculation-evidence/readiness boundary rather than claiming formula validation.

No candidate is a ship-owned selector or relationship whose range associates the ship with otherIceStrengthenedAreaValue; iceStrengthenedArea is an xsd:string datatype property and cannot provide that link.
No supplied candidate represents load-patch aspect ratio (AR) or the downstream maximum/use obligations for F, Q, P, Pavg, b, and w.
No supplied candidate is semantically supported as the missing canonical alpha_i quantity term; the available quantity properties represent other operands or coefficients.
No candidate is a canonical ship-to-case relationship; the supplied properties and classes cannot satisfy the required relationship mismatch.
No supplied candidate represents the absent canonical hull-area/localized-member selector evidence or Table 3 entry/value term required by the feedback.
No supplied candidate represents the required relationship or result term linking a hull area to its factor or a structural member to the factor used in scantling determination.
No supplied candidate canonically represents the omitted operands AF or b; the available terms describe thickness, pressure, spacing, framing angle, frame, or ship.
No supplied canonical candidate represents either required formula operand b or AF; the available terms describe thickness, pressure, framing angle, ship ownership, or component relationships.

No supplied candidate denotes a canonical linear-interpolation endpoint or operand; interpolatedNetPlateThickness is the result quantity, while the remaining candidates represent the case, relationship, applicability angle, boolean flag, owner, or general structural concepts.
No candidate is a verified relationship/applicability property for continuity through a support, bracket attachment, or termination within an ice-strengthened area.
No candidate is verified because the supplied terms do not represent calculation-input evidence, flange-fitted branch selection, or material inclusion/exclusion semantics.
No supplied candidate defines controlled roles or quantities for the linear-interpolation endpoints; the available terms do not semantically satisfy the requested endpoint distinction.
No candidate is verified because none represents the required applicability or branch-selection evidence for bottom local frames in BIb/Mb/Sb versus transverse local frames in side structures.
No canonical candidate is semantically verified for either load-patch height b or area factor AF; the supplied span and factor terms represent different quantities.

No candidate is verified as the canonical midspan-load quantity or definition relationship term; span denotes a length, while plasticStrength and plasticCollapseMechanism do not encode the required defining load relationship.
No supplied candidate is semantically supported for the missing AF or b properties or required modeled intermediates.
No supplied candidate defines the required section-type selector or controlled values for flat-bar, bulb, tee, and angle sections.
No candidate provides the verified Polar Class class/date applicability selector requested by the validator; polarClass is only a Stage 1 candidate pending vocabulary approval.
No candidate provides the absent canonical ordered-grade or comparison term needed for a Table 8 minimum-grade comparison; steelGrade is string-valued and must not be used for lexical ordering.

Repair the COMPLETE dependency contract encoding: crushingFailureClassFactor is declared as both an applicability term and a result term but is only required for presence and is unused by any applicability or calculation constraint. Encode its declared semantic role without altering the verified F_IB formulas, or correct the upstream dependency contract before regeneration; do not freeze a presence-only approximation of a declared selector/result.
No supplied candidate is the canonical ship-to-calculation-case relationship requested by the validator; calculationCase is a class, not the required relationship property.
No candidate is a numeric quantity result property with decimal range and compatible unit; all supplied candidates are classes.
No candidate is the canonical ship-to-calculation-case relationship; hasInterpolationPoint links a calculation case to interpolation points and is not semantically interchangeable.
No candidate is a relationship or applicability term connecting a ship or structural member to a cut-out; the supplied terms cannot constrain members specifically in way of cut-outs.
No supplied candidate defines a canonical ship-owned calculation-method relationship/path; nltl:calculationMethod is scoped to nltl:calculationCase and cannot be asserted directly on nltl:ship.
No supplied candidate is verified for I2-064: calculationMethod is scoped to other cited requirements, and ship is a class rather than an applicability or branch-selection term.
No supplied candidate defines the missing evidence or comparison roles, deformation-versus-dimension operands or results, units, or comparison semantics required by the feedback.
No supplied candidate is a canonical relationship or source-specific evidence/date path satisfying the validator feedback.
No supplied candidate is a canonical case-to-result/evidence relationship or otherwise verifies per-loading-condition ownership of the s_i value or approved alternative evidence.

Remove sh:minCount 1 from the hasRelevantHatchOrDoor property in the true branch. The requirement constrains every relevant hatch or door that is linked; it does not assert that at least one such item must exist. Retain sh:class and sh:node so every existing linked relevant item must have hasIceOrSnowRemovalOrPreventionMeans.

No supplied candidate provides canonical localControlItem-owned protection and continuous-accessibility properties or an equivalent per-item evidence model; hasLocalControlItem only supplies the already-retained relationship and cannot encode both item-level Boolean checks.
No candidate is verified because none provides an item-owned compatibility or approval term; intendedOperationCompatibilityStatus is ship-owned and must not be moved to extinguishingMediumItem.

No supplied candidate provides canonical section-owned isolation and drainage properties or another complete per-item model; the boolean properties are ship-owned, and hasExposedFireMainSection alone cannot encode the required per-section conjunction.
No supplied candidate is a route-owned status or evidence property; the candidates only represent the ship-to-route relationship, the exposed-route class, or the ship class.

No supplied candidate is a verified searchlight-owned continuous-use approval or suitability term; continuousUseSuitabilityStatus is authoritatively ship-owned, so it must not be duplicated on searchlight nodes.
No supplied candidate is a canonical ship-to-lifeboat inventory relationship; the available terms describe the lifeboat class, type classification, or controlled type values.
No supplied candidate represents the required ship-to-crew-member inventory relationship; hasPassenger is specifically the passenger relationship and cannot be reused or modified.
No candidate is semantically supported because none represents a per-craft relationship for a location-signal device or an on-scene transmit/receive device.
No supplied candidate defines the missing crew-to-training-record relationship or the required controlled ice-condition, ship-type, crew-role, training-level, and STCW-status values.
No candidate defines the required relationship linking each familiarization record to its specific relevant PWOM item.

No supplied candidate is an approved antenna-owned ice-accumulation-prevention evidence property; iceAccumulationPreventionMeansPresent is ship-owned and must not be moved to or duplicated on antenna nodes.

No candidate is verified because the feedback requires Table 4-8 selector/evidence and ship-to-lookup-case relationship properties, while the supplied candidates provide only quantity properties and classes; tableLookupCase is a class, not the required selector, evidence, or relationship term.
No supplied candidate is a ship-owned relationship property connecting the ship to strut design, strength, or hull-attachment evidence.

No supplied candidate represents the required design-load scope or the explicit stopped-propeller-dragging and radial-ice-entry exclusions; the applicability terms and ice-class values cannot substitute for those facts.
No supplied candidate is a canonical relationship term connecting the design condition to the ship.
No supplied candidate represents the required applicable-class or propeller-location selector/controlled-value concept; the candidates are integer load-cycle counts.
No supplied candidate represents the required propeller-diameter D quantity with the necessary quantity range and length unit.

No supplied candidate is a canonical ship-to-tableLookupCase relationship, exact Table 6-8 selector, or lookup value relationship; tableLookupApplied is only a boolean on tableLookupCase and cannot encode the required evidence.

No supplied candidate is a canonical ship-to-table-lookup-case relationship or a Table 6-9 selection/evidence term; tableLookupCase and tableLookupApplied alone cannot connect the case to the ship or identify the cited table exactly.

The shape is only a presence/datatype/unit check and omits the required alternative: use the known bollard-MCR speed, otherwise derive/select it from Table 6-9 using propellerDiameter (D_m). Add explicit, non-accidental branch-selection evidence and enforce the Table 6-9 lookup, its diameter operand, selected result, and cited-table relationship while retaining ship as the target and rev/min as the result unit. Locate canonical terms for the missing lookup-case relationship, table identity/rows, branch evidence, and selected result rather than inventing them; do not place tableLookupApplied directly on an entity incompatible with its canonical domain.
No candidate provides the required canonical table selector/input, lookup-result, or relationship/evidence semantics needed to compare maximumEngineTorque with the value selected from Table 6-10.
No supplied candidate is a verified case-level selector or relationship for the ice-milling sequence; propellerIceMillingLoadSequence is explicitly ship-owned and must not be placed on a loadCase.
No candidate is a canonical ship-to-load-case relationship; the supplied terms are classes or a named individual, not a relationship property.
No candidate is a verified explicit unknown selector for stressLifeCurveType; complianceStateUnknown belongs to the complianceState range and is semantically incompatible.

No supplied candidate denotes a fatigue safety-factor result; componentYieldSafetyFactor and yieldSafetyFactor are explicitly limited to yielding, while the remaining candidates represent loads, load-case typing, or classes.

No candidate is verified because the feedback requires distinct bending and torsional stress-mode safety-factor results plus formula operands, while the supplied quantity properties are generic or component-level and cannot independently evidence both stress modes.
No exact term can be used because none of the supplied candidates represents the required thruster resistance/capacity or withstand-comparison result.

Replace the presence-only quantity checks with a bounded formula constraint. The COMPLETE dependency contract requires nonHemisphericalImpactContactArea as the operand and designIceThickness as the result, both on the ship; the candidate instead treats equivalentImpactSphereRadius as the result and never validates the required equation. Compare the reported derived result against the expected formula value using tolerance scaled from the expected value, while retaining the required M2 and M units and avoiding exact decimal equality.

No supplied candidate is verified as a ship-owned yield-strength operand: materialYieldStrength has the reported shipComponent-domain mismatch, while yieldStrength does not cite TRF-118 or establish ship ownership.

No supplied candidate is the required canonical ship-to-calculation-case relationship; ship and calculationCase are classes, while the remaining candidates represent quantities, directions, or damping.
No supplied candidate denotes the missing applicable stress quantity, ship/component-to-load-case relationship, or occasional-force/propeller-blade selector required by the feedback.

No supplied candidate represents the missing spatial relationships or reference selectors; draughtMarkAftOffset is only a quantity and cannot encode the required reference point or conditional aft-location alternative.
